without_item.speaker: right
without_item.name: Pink Bunny
without_item.text: It's locked. I'll need something to get in - like a key, maybe?

with_item.speaker: right
with_item.name: Pink Bunny
with_item.text: The pink key fits the lock. I can open the path now!

key_spent.speaker: right
key_spent.name: Pink Bunny
key_spent.text: The door is open. I don't need this key anymore.

key_kept.speaker: right
key_kept.name: Pink Bunny
key_kept.text: The door is open, but I think I'll still need this key. I'll keep it.
